description: The additive heuristic h^add estimates the cost from a state to the goal of a planning task. It uses the *delete relaxation*: actions only add facts and never remove them. A fact true in the state costs 0. Any other fact costs the minimum, over the rules that add it, of the rule's cost plus the sum of its conditions' costs. h^add is the sum of these costs over all goal facts. It is not *admissible* (it can overestimate the true cost), because it counts a shared subgoal once for each goal that needs it, so use it to guide greedy search or, as BFWS-f5 does, take its *best supporters* to build a relaxed plan.
